{{Quote|We believe there may even be descendents of exiles from the Old Republic who do not know that the political order has changed for the better, that the Emperor's New Order has replaced the corruption and unpleasantness.|Pollux Hax|<ref name="ISWU" />}}
'''Pollux Hax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] who served the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and was one of his most trusted [[Aide/Legends|aides]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|28|Hax, Pollux}}</ref> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], he had been the [[Chief/Legends|chief]] of the Emperor's [[Propaganda Dissemination Section]] for several years. Hax was notably commissioned to write an article promoting the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Pollux Hax praised the Emperor's [[New Order/Legends|political ideology]] throughout the article.<ref name="ISWU" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|To understand the depth of the Emperor's tolerance, one needs only to observe the cultural areas he has allowed to exist in segregated parts of the city.|Pollux Hax|<ref name="ISWU" />}}
Pollux Hax was a tall, gaunt humanoid with sallow skin, deep set [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and sunken cheeks. He [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] long, concealing [[Robe/Legends|robes]] that came in various shades of [[Color/Legends|purple]] and black.<ref name="ISWU" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pollux Hax was one of the in-universe authors of ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]'', a reference book published in [[1995]]. His portrait in the book was a reused piece of concept art originally drawn by [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]] for [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. The facial structure of Pollux Hax resembles that of the [[Shi'ido]], [[Mammon Hoole]].
